Hi Samira / Ben — I jumped in to help with the calendar behavior. A couple quick notes for reliability across Outlook tenants: 

  1) Redeliver the invite using an ICS that explicitly includes the ORGANIZER and X-MICROSOFT-CDO-BUSYSTATUS fields. That avoids some forwarding scrubs. Ben, thanks for sending the redwood-zoom-bridge.ics — if Outlook still hides the link we'll take the next step below.
  2) If the customer's tenant rewrites body content, the simplest operational fix is to send a separate calendar attachment + a short email that includes the raw join URL (so there's a text fallback).
  3) As a longer-term fix for large accounts, our onboarding playbook suggests using a shared mailbox booking@redwood.ai as organizer for enterprise invites — that reduces tenant rewriting.

I've uploaded a short step-by-step for our CS/OPS team and linked it here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1o4-demo-notes. Ben — if you want, I can reissue the invite from booking@redwood.ai; say the word and I'll take it.
